title: Schema V3: outbox composite PK + kind column
description:
Add SCHEMA_V3 migration to kith-store to fix group-chat fanout and enable receipt delivery.

**What:** Recreate the outbox table with a composite PRIMARY KEY (message_id, peer_user_id, kind) and add kind/read_at_unix columns.

**Why the single-column PK is a bug:** process_create calls outbox().enqueue(msg_id, peer_A), then enqueue(msg_id, peer_B) for group chat. The second call fails with UNIQUE constraint violation on message_id. The error is silently swallowed via let _ = ..., so only the first participant gets the message.

**Algorithm:**
1. In crates/kith-store/src/lib.rs, after SCHEMA_V2 add:
   const SCHEMA_V3: &str = "
   CREATE TABLE outbox_v3 (
       message_id        TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES messages(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
       peer_user_id      TEXT NOT NULL,
       peer_mailbox_host TEXT NOT NULL,
       kind              TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'message' CHECK(kind IN ('message', 'receipt')),
       read_at_unix      INTEGER,
       next_attempt_at   INTEGER NOT NULL,
       attempt_count     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
       last_error        TEXT,
       PRIMARY KEY (message_id, peer_user_id, kind)
   );
   INSERT INTO outbox_v3
       SELECT message_id, peer_user_id, peer_mailbox_host, 'message', NULL,
              next_attempt_at, attempt_count, last_error
       FROM outbox;
   DROP TABLE outbox;
   ALTER TABLE outbox_v3 RENAME TO outbox;
   CREATE INDEX outbox_next ON outbox(next_attempt_at);
   ";
2. Add (3, SCHEMA_V3) to MIGRATIONS array.
3. Run cargo test -p kith-store — all existing tests must pass (open_in_memory() applies all migrations; the V3 migration should not break any existing test since it is backward-compatible with the current single-peer-per-message usage).

**Defensive programming rules:**
- Migration SQL must be in a single SCHEMA_V3 string (executed in one tx by the runner).
- No data is lost: INSERT INTO outbox_v3 ... FROM outbox preserves all existing rows.
- CHECK constraint ensures kind is either 'message' or 'receipt' — no other values accepted.
- read_at_unix is nullable (NULL for kind='message').

**Agent team:** Single implementer (R + I); schema-only change. No Tester needed — existing tests cover migration correctness.

**Tests:** cargo test -p kith-store must pass clean (all existing outbox tests exercise the migrated table). No new tests needed for the migration itself — test coverage comes from Z9LY.2.
